name: insights_active_entities_info_ttl_secs
description: TTL (seconds) for cached active entity information. After expiry, active entities info is recomputed. Default 21600 = 6 hours.

name: insights_auto_register
description: Enables auto-registration of entity types and metrics from config files at startup. When true, IDF auto-registers schema without manual RPC calls.

name: insights_cursor_queries_enabled
description: Master switch for cursor-based paginated queries. When false, cursor_query_info in queries is ignored.

name: insights_cursor_query_max_custom_expiration_time_secs
description: Maximum custom_expiration_time_secs a client can set for cursor queries. Requests exceeding this value are capped. Default 120s.

name: insights_cursor_query_objects_expiration_time_secs
description: How long (seconds) a cursor query object remains valid. After this, the cursor is purged and subsequent pagination calls fail. Default 30s.

name: insights_deleted_entity_default_retention_in_secs
description: How long (seconds) a deleted entity is retained before permanent purge. Default 604800 = 7 days. Entities deleted via DeleteEntity remain queryable during this window.

name: insights_deleted_federated_entity_default_retention_in_secs
description: Retention for deleted federated entities. Default 2592000 = 30 days. Federated entities replicated from PC are kept longer for convergence.

name: insights_disable_gewm
description: Completely disables GetEntitiesWithMetrics RPC. When true, all GEWM queries are rejected. Used during maintenance.

name: insights_disable_metricdata_rpc
description: Globally disables MetricData RPC. When true, PutMetricData and GetMetricData are rejected. Individual metrics can override.

name: insights_enable_heavy_metric_sort
description: Allows sorting on non-indexed metric columns (requires full scan). Disabling prevents expensive sort operations.

name: insights_enable_watch_processing
description: Master switch for watch processing. When false, RegisterWatch and all watch RPCs are disabled.

name: insights_entity_tombstone_purging_process_schedule_interval_seconds
description: How frequently (seconds) the tombstone purging process runs. Even if retention expires, entities aren't purged until this process runs. Default 604800 = 7 days.

name: insights_experimental_evict_evictable_entity
description: Forces immediate eviction of evictable entities from cache. Testing-only flag for eviction behavior.

name: insights_high_memory_usage_rpc_throttling
description: Enable throttling when server memory usage is high. When true and memory exceeds threshold, low-priority RPCs are rejected.

name: insights_high_memory_usage_rpc_throttling_pct
description: Memory usage percentage threshold for triggering RPC throttling. Default 90%.

name: insights_high_num_outstanding_ops_rpc_throttling
description: Enable throttling when too many outstanding ops. When true and queues are full, new RPCs are rejected.

name: insights_lookup_query_batch_size
description: Batch size for internal lookup operations during query processing. Larger = more throughput but more memory. Default 512.

name: insights_max_entities_num_in_batch_update
description: Max entities in a single batch update RPC. Split larger batches. Default 1000.

name: insights_max_entities_per_batch_del
description: Max entities deletable in one batch. Larger batches must be split. Default 50.

name: insights_max_fired_watches_per_client
description: Maximum fired watches a single client can accumulate. Older notifications may be dropped if exceeded. Default 100000.

name: insights_max_fired_watches_per_long_poll
description: Max fired watches returned per long-poll. Client must issue another poll for remaining. Default 500.

name: insights_max_num_queries_in_batch_gewm
description: Maximum queries in a single BatchGetEntitiesWithMetrics RPC. Server rejects if exceeded. Default 50.

name: insights_max_outstanding_high_memory_rpc_ops
description: Max concurrent RPC ops in the high-memory queue. Very constrained (default 1) to prevent OOM for extremely large queries.

name: insights_max_outstanding_low_memory_rpc_ops
description: Max concurrent RPC ops in the low-memory queue. Limits parallelism for memory-intensive operations. Default 8.

name: insights_max_queued_rpc_ops
description: Maximum RPC operations that can be queued. When full, new RPCs are rejected/throttled. Default 25.

name: insights_max_rpc_queue_time_secs
description: Maximum time (seconds) an RPC can sit in the queue before being dropped with kDroppedBecauseQueuedForTooLong. Default 30s.

name: insights_metric_data_hourly_retention_period_in_weeks
description: Default retention (weeks) for hourly downsampled metric data. Default 52 = 1 year. Override per-metric via hourly_retention_in_weeks.

name: insights_metric_data_raw_retention_period_in_weeks
description: Default retention (weeks) for raw metric time-series data. After this period, raw data points are purged. Override per-metric via raw_retention_in_weeks in MetricTypeConfig.

name: insights_query_max_values_for_kcorrelate
description: Max total list values across entities for kCorrelate queries. Exceeding this returns kQueryCorrelateNumValuesLimitExceeded. Default 2000000.

name: insights_watch_client_staleness_limit_secs
description: If a watch client hasn't polled for this many seconds, it's considered stale and auto-unregistered. Default 300 = 5 min.
